Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Sliding-Top Coffee Table, 47"W
Colors: Walnut
Materials: Metal
A light wood-patterned top slides away to reveal extra storage in this modern coffee table. Avoid mess and keep needed items close at hand. Strong metal legs give support. The natural coloring means that this item will match most color schemes, making it a must-have in any casual living space. 47"W x 24"D x 13"H MDF and metal The wood finish will match any decor. Sliding top Assemble in 15-30 minutes Clean with a soft cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
